# secureaccess_private_resource (Resource)

This resource manages a Private Resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_private_resource" "example" {
  name           = "my private resource"
  description    = "This is my private resource"
  certificate_id = 123456
  dns_server_id  = 789012
  endpoint_connection_methods = [
    {
      type                       = "client"
      client_reachable_addresses = ["192.168.1.0/24"]
    }
  ]
  addresses = [
    {
      addresses = ["192.168.1.0/24"]
      protocols_and_ports = [
        {
          protocol = "http/https"
          ports    = "443"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `addresses` (Attributes List) The list of resource addresses for the Private Resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addresses))
- `endpoint_connection_methods` (Attributes List) The list of connection properties that describe how end users can access private resources in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoint_connection_methods))
- `name` (String) Name of the Private Resource

### Optional

- `certificate_id` (Number) The ID of the certificate you use to decrypt traffic to the Private Resource.
- `description` (String) Description of the Private Resource
- `dns_server_id` (Number) The ID of the DNS server you use to resolve IP addresses.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addresses`

Required:

- `addresses` (List of String) The list of IPv4 addresses, CIDRs, FQDNs, or wildcard FQDN destinations.
- `protocols_and_ports` (Attributes List) The list of protocols and ports for the IP address destinations. The protocols must be unique. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addresses--protocols_and_ports))

<a id="nestedatt--addresses--protocols_and_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addresses.protocols_and_ports`

Required:

- `ports` (String) The port number or list of comma-separated port numbers that you can use to connect to the Private Resource.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol for the IP address destination.
  - Choices: `any`, `tcp`, `udp`, `http/https`, `ssh`, `rdp-tcp`



<a id="nestedatt--endpoint_connection_methods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoint_connection_methods`

Optional:

- `browser_external_fqdn_prefix` (String) The external fully qualified domain name (FQDN) prefix.
- `browser_protocol` (String) The protocol that is used for the communication between the proxy and the Private Resource.
  - Choices: `HTTP`, `HTTPS`
- `browser_sni` (String) The Server Name Indication (SNI) domain name.
- `browser_ssl_verification` (Boolean) Specify whether to enable upstream SSL verification for the internally hosted URL by the customer.
- `client_reachable_addresses` (List of String) The list of IP address, CIDRs, FQDN, or wildcard FQDN destinations.
- `type` (String) The type of access for the private resource. Each type can be listed once only.
  - Choices: `browser`, `network`, `client`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_private_resource.example "<id>"
```
